episodes.title: Por encima de todo
episodes.summary: Joaquín Sorolla public hospital admits a notable patient. An overdose hits close to home for Pilar, while Rodri treats a child in distress.

episodes.title: Madera de médico
episodes.summary: Rodri's troubles escalate. Biel confronts Jésica about her relationship with Lluís. Meanwhile, Leo and May clash over a victim of a sexual assault.

episodes.title: Paramos
episodes.summary: Jésica faces the unimaginable as protests erupt at the hospital. Néstor struggles to get along with Patricia. Leo and Lluís find themselves in a dilemma.

episodes.title: Confío en ti
episodes.summary: Patricia agrees to proceed with the expedited surgery. Jésica breaks down. The strike compels team members to take unthinkable actions.

episodes.title: Huelga
episodes.summary: Pilar takes charge at the hospital as the strike puts Néstor and Patricia under pressure. Quique embraces his feelings, while Biel faces disappointment.

episodes.title: El último hombre en pie
episodes.summary: A prison fire creates a frenzy in the ER. While Biel and Jésica's relationship becomes muddled, Patricia and Néstor agree to meet face-to-face on TV.

episodes.title: Tierra quemada
episodes.summary: The consequences of the strike put Néstor's career in the line of fire. May's water breaks at her worst moment with Rocío.

episodes.title: Gota fría
episodes.summary: The crew scrambles when a cold front threatens to turn into a crisis, and things heat up for Biel and Jésica once more. Patricia makes a surprising move.

episodes.title: Cambios
episodes.summary: As the hospital transitions to private management, a renowned doctor joins the team with positive news for Patricia. Jésica's condition remains critical.

episodes.title: Miedo
episodes.summary: Néstor has trouble working with the new head of Oncology, as Lluís and Biel seek a donor for Jésica. A patient's faith puts May in a difficult position.

episodes.title: Estado crítico
episodes.summary: Jon's influence on Quique leads to trouble. Biel is blindsided when family complications show up at work. Patricia receives a disturbing warning.

episodes.title: Primero, no hacer daño
episodes.summary: Néstor's suspicions about Sophie grow, and Patricia helps him investigate her past. As the ER buckles, Pilar's decisions push Jésica to the brink.

episodes.title: Culpa y perdón
episodes.summary: Quique confronts Jon as patients arrive at the ER with similar symptoms, which the team fears may be linked. Lluís' new romantic status spreads fast.

episodes.title: Por un futuro mejor
episodes.summary: Pilar and Nicolás clash over hospital management. As Patricia's election looms, Néstor digs deeper into Sophie's work. Rocío finds herself in trouble.

episodes.title: El día más largo
episodes.summary: As Néstor and Biel plot to regain Sophie's trust, an explosion at a school sends a wave of patients to the hospital. A new doctor arrives unannounced.

episodes.title: Elecciones
episodes.summary: It's Election Day. The investigation into Sophie comes to a head, while Biel's new romance stirs old feelings and causes trouble at the hospital.
